info.title: Heron Broadcaster API
info.description: Control plane of Heron Broadcaster. Sign in with `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (session cookie, plus an `X-Requested-With` header on requests that change something) or send an API token as `Authorization: Bearer heron_…`.

put.summary:
Moves a name to another artist (or to a new one): the tracks tagged
with it follow. Operators and admins.

get.summary: Links waiting for review.

post.summary: Accepts or dismisses a suggestion. Operators and admins.

get.summary: Artists, by name.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matches any of the artist's names.

patch.summary: Renames an artist, or sets its MusicBrainz ID. Operators and admins.

post.summary:
Merges another artist into this one: its names, tracks, similar
artists and restrictions. Operators and admins.

put.summary:
Marks two artists similar: separation treats them as the same artist.
Operators and admins.

post.summary: Signs in: answers with the user and sets the `heron_session` cookie.

429.description: Too many failures for this username

post.summary: Signs out: ends the session and clears the cookie.

get.summary: The signed-in user.

put.summary: Changes your password. Your other sessions are signed out.
Saves your preferences: the web UI's theme.

post.summary: Operators and admins.

put.summary:
Renames, recolors a category or changes its separation. Operators and
admins.

delete.summary:
Deletes a category and its restrictions; its tracks stay in the
library. Refused while a clock uses it. Operators and admins.

post.summary: Operators and admins.

A clock as it will sound, from its slots (saved or not): expected
starts and lengths, and the categories running short.

put.summary: Renames a clock and replaces its slots. Operators and admins.

delete.summary:
Deletes a clock; the hours it was scheduled at rotate the whole library
until another clock is scheduled. Operators and admins.

post.summary: Adds an encoder profile. Admins only.

put.summary:
Replaces an encoder profile. Outputs using it restart with the new
encoding. Admins only.

delete.summary: Deletes an encoder profile no output uses. Admins only.

get.summary: Plays, most recent first.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Plays started before this time (Unix ms), for the next page.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Plays started at or after this time (Unix ms).

parameters.name: exclude_fx
parameters.description: Leave out the FX player (jingles played over the music).

get.summary: The most recent batches of file operations, newest first.

post.summary:
Reverts a batch: files go back to their previous paths and get their
previous tags back. Nothing is overwritten: a file whose previous path
is taken stays where it is (see the task's report). Admins.

Asks for a dry run of organizing the library with the layout in the
library settings: the task's `plan` lists every move, nothing changes.
Admins.

Carries out the moves of a finished dry run, as one batch that can be
undone. Tracks moved since the dry run are skipped. Admins.

get.summary:
Tracks whose identification was not confident enough to apply, with the
releases they may be on.
Import and analysis progress. No sign-in needed.
The most recent library tasks, newest first.
A library task, with its result once done.
Opens the live WebSocket. Messages are [`LiveMessage`]s.

parameters.name: levels
parameters.description: Send levels ten times a second (default true).

get.summary: Outputs with their live state.

post.summary:
Adds an output; the engine starts streaming to it if it is enabled.
Admins only.

put.summary: Replaces an output. Credentials left out of `config` are kept. Admins only.

delete.summary: Deletes an output; the engine stops streaming to it. Admins only.

get.summary: Decks, queue and outputs, read from the engine now.

post.summary:
Plays a library track on the FX player, over the music. Replaces the
FX playing, if any.

get.summary: Peak and RMS levels (dBFS) of the master bus and each deck.

post.summary: Fades out and holds the decks; the stream goes on with silence.
Fades out the track on air and starts the next one.

Plans the transition between two tracks the way the engine would, for
previews. Nothing is played.

get.summary: The tracks waiting to play, in order: the cued one first.

post.summary:
Queues library tracks. Missing files and tracks with nothing audible are
refused.

delete.summary:
Empties the queue, cued track included. The track on air plays on (and
autofill, when on, queues new tracks).
Takes an entry out of the queue. The track on air cannot be removed: skip it.

post.summary: Operators and admins.

get.summary: The selection log, most recent first.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Picks before this one, for the next page.

post.summary:
Generates programming offline, without touching the queue, and checks
it: separation as relaxed at each pick's step, restrictions always.
Operators and admins.

get.summary: Which clock runs when; hours left out rotate the whole library.

put.summary: Replaces the whole schedule. Operators and admins.

get.summary: Gap Killer and crossfade point detection, used at import.

put.summary:
Replaces the analysis settings. Every track is analyzed again with the
new settings, in the background. Admins only.

get.summary: Identification and folder layout, used by `heron-librarian`.

patch.summary: Changes some library settings; the others are kept. Admins only.

get.summary: Crossfades and loudness normalization.

put.summary:
Replaces the playout settings (missing fields take the defaults) and
pushes them to the engine. Admins only.
Replaces the queue manager settings. Operators and admins.

get.summary: Separation rules, the fallback category and weights.

put.summary:
Replaces the rotation settings (missing fields take the defaults).
Operators and admins.
Replaces the station settings. Admins only.

get.summary:
Whether the API, its database and the engine are up, and whether the
server clock can be trusted. No sign-in needed.
Your API tokens (not revoked). The tokens themselves are never shown again.

post.summary: Creates an API token acting as you, with your role.

delete.summary: Revokes one of your API tokens (admins: anyone's).

get.summary: Library tracks, searched, filtered and sorted, a page at a time.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words found in the title, artist, album or path.

get.summary: A track with its analysis, overrides, categories and identification.

patch.summary: Enables or disables a track. Operators and admins.

get.summary:
The track's audio file as it is in the library, for previews in the
browser. Supports range requests.

put.summary: Replaces the track's categories. Operators and admins.

Replaces the track's overrides: cue points, Gap Killer, crossfade.
Missing fields use the analysis and station settings. Queued entries of
the track are updated within seconds. Operators and admins.

delete.summary: Removes the track's overrides. Operators and admins.

post.summary:
Applies one of the track's candidate releases: heron-librarian writes
its tags into the file and files it where the layout says, as a batch
that can be undone. Operators and admins.

Marks the track as reviewed: its file keeps its own tags. Operators and
admins.

get.summary:
The track's waveform overview, computed with its analysis. 404 until
the track is analyzed.
Every user. Admins only.

post.summary: Admins only.

delete.summary: Deletes a user with their sessions and tokens. Admins only.

patch.summary:
Changes a user's role, enables or disables them, or resets their
password. Admins only.

AnalysisSettings.description:
Parameters of the import-time analysis (Gap Killer and crossfade point
detection). Stored under the `analysis` settings name.

Levels are in dB **relative to the track's integrated loudness**, so the
same thresholds work for quiet and loud masters. See `docs/analysis.md`.

blip_max_ms.description: Bursts of sound this short, surrounded by silence, are ignored.

end_threshold_db.description: Audio quieter than this at the end of a track is trimmed.

fade_max_ms.description: Longest distance between the crossfade point and the end of the track.

fade_min_ms.description: Shortest distance between the crossfade point and the end of the track.

fade_trigger_db.description: The crossfade starts after the last moment the track is louder than this.

max_internal_silence_ms.description: Silence longer than this inside a track ends the track there.

silence_ceiling_dbfs.description:
Absolute ceiling (dBFS) for what counts as silence: quiet but audible
passages above it are never trimmed, whatever the track's loudness.

start_threshold_db.description: Audio quieter than this at the start of a track is trimmed.

similar.description: Separation treats these as the same artist.

by_hand.description: Moved to this artist by hand.

finished_at_unix_ms.description: `None` while it runs, or when it was interrupted.

undoes.description: For an undo, the batch it undoes.

BatchReport.description: What a batch of file operations did.

skipped.description: Operations not done, with the reason.

separation.description:
Windows this category overrides; the others follow the rotation
settings (clock slots can override them again).

weight.description: Relative chance of being picked within the category, 1 by default.

looping.description: Off by default: the clock starts over at each hour.

duration_ms.description: Expected length of the whole clock.

runs_per_hour.description:
How many times the clock runs in an hour: more than 1 when it is
shorter than the hour; under 1 for a looping clock longer than it.

ClockSlot.description: How a slot calls its category.

enforce_rules.description: Off, the slot skips the separation rules (restrictions still apply).

separation.description: Windows this slot overrides, over its category's.

estimated_error_ms.description: The kernel's estimate of the clock's error, in ms.

offset_ms.description: The offset the kernel is correcting, in ms.

synchronized.description: `None` where the kernel's state cannot be read (not Linux).

warning.description:
Why the clock cannot be trusted, for people. `None` when it is fine
or unknown.

looping.description: Carries on from its last slot across hours instead of starting over.

scheduled_hours.description: Hours of the week it is scheduled at.

token.description: Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Shown only once.

CrossfadeOverrides.description:
Per-track crossfade overrides (`track_overrides.crossfade`). Missing fields
use the station settings. The fade-out, mode and fixed time apply to the
transition out of the track; the fade-in to the transition into it.

crossfade.description: `false` plays the transition out of this track back to back, without overlap.

CrossfadeSettings.description:
Station-wide crossfade settings, modeled on SAM Broadcaster's
"Cross-Fading" screen. Stored under `playout` in the `settings` table.

fade_out.description: Fade-out of the outgoing track, from the moment the next one starts.

fixed_ms.description: With [`CrossfadeMode::Fixed`], how long before the cue-out the next track starts.

min_track_ms.description:
Tracks this long or shorter (jingles, IDs) are never crossfaded: they
start right after the previous track and the next starts right after them.

skip_fade_ms.description: Fade-out of the current track when it is skipped.

oneOf.description: Missing when the deck is empty.

on_air.description: The track listeners hear as "now playing".

EffectivePlayout.description: How the engine will play the track: analysis and overrides combined.

gain_db.description: Loudness normalization gain with the current playout settings.

EngineStatus.description: Whether the engine is reachable and runs the stored configuration.

position.description: Where among the waiting tracks, 0 being next. At the end when missing.

track_ids.description: Library tracks, played in this order.

Explanation.description: Why a track was picked: the selection log.

at_unix_ms.description: When the track is planned to start (Unix ms).

blocked.description:
Tracks of the slot's category held back by each separation rule
with the rules as configured (the first rule that applies counts).

oneOf.description:
Category the track was picked from: the fallback category from
step 9; missing for the whole library.
Missing when no clock is scheduled: the whole library rotates.

last_played_unix_ms.description: When the picked track last played; missing if never.

method.description: Applied: least recently played at step 10.

skipped_slots.description: Slots passed over because nothing could be picked, even relaxed.

slot.description: Index of the slot in the clock, from 0.

oneOf.description: Category the slot calls.

weight.description: Weight of the picked track in its category.

windows.description: Separation windows applied at this step.

level_pct.description: Level the fade-out goes down to, or the fade-in starts from, in percent.

LibrarySettingsPatch.description: Changes to the library settings: missing fields are kept.

acoustid_key.description: The station's AcoustID application key; `null` removes it.

min_score.description: Lowest AcoustID score (0 to 1) accepted as a match.

LibrarySettingsView.description: Library settings as shown: the AcoustID key is never sent back.

acoustid_key_set.description: Whether the station has set its AcoustID key (identification is off without one).

LibraryStatus.description: Library and analysis progress, served by `/api/v1/library/status`.

analyzed.description: Present tracks with an up-to-date analysis.

oneOf.description: The moves of a finished dry run (`organize_plan`).
What a finished MusicBrainz relationships lookup found.
What a finished apply, undo or review did.
Missing while the engine is unreachable.

LiveMessage.description: A message on the live WebSocket.

LoudnessSettings.description: Loudness normalization from the analyzed integrated loudness (EBU R128).

max_gain_db.description: Quiet tracks are boosted by at most this much.

peak_ceiling_dbtp.description:
Boosts never push the track's true peak above this. There is no
limiter before M9, so a boost that clips would distort.

artist_id.description: The artist merged into this one, then deleted.

Method.description: How a clock slot picks among the tracks its category allows.

artist_id.description:
The artist the name now belongs to; missing to make it an artist
of its own.

position.description: New place among the waiting tracks, 0 being next.

OrganizePlan.description: The dry run of an organization.

unchanged.description: Tracks already where the layout puts them.

unreadable.description: Tracks whose file cannot be read (left where they are).

config.description: Sink settings. Credentials left out keep their stored value.

OutputStatus.description: The live state of an output, as the engine reports it.

error.description: Why the last connection failed, while reconnecting.

config.description: Sink settings (Icecast: host, port, mount…), without credentials.

secrets_set.description: Credentials set in the settings (e.g. `password`), never sent back.

oneOf.description:
Live state from the engine; missing while it is unreachable or
before the output reaches it.

`finished`, `skipped`, `stopped` or `replaced`; missing while the
track plays, or when the API missed the end.

track_id.description: Missing for files outside the library, and tracks deleted since.

PlayerState.description: Decks, queue and outputs of the engine.

oneOf.description: Loaded and waiting for its transition.

rendered_ms.description: Audio rendered since the engine started.

PlayoutSettings.description:
Playout settings, stored under `playout` in the `settings` table and
pushed to the engine.

looping.description: Whether the clock loops across hours.

slots.description: The slots as edited, saved or not.

entry_id.description: Assigned by the engine, unique until it restarts.

QueueSettings.description:
The queue manager. Until rotation and clockwheels (M6), it keeps the
engine's queue filled with the least recently played tracks.

autofill.description:
Add tracks when the queue runs low. Off, the station plays silence
once the queue is empty.

min_queued.description: Tracks kept waiting (cued and queued), 1 to 50.

QueuedTrack.description: A track as the engine holds it.

cue_in_ms.description: Cue points the engine plays between, overrides applied.

track_id.description: Library track, when the track comes from the library.

RampView.description: A gain ramp, in ms on its track's own timeline.

level.description: Level at the quiet end of the ramp, 0 to 1.

RelationsReport.description: What a MusicBrainz relationships lookup found.

artists.description: Artists with a MusicBrainz ID looked up.

failed.description: Lookups that failed (tried again next time).

suggestions.description: New suggestions, between two artists of the station.

target_name.description: The track (`artist – title`), artist or category, for people.

ReviewCandidate.description: A release a track may be on, from AcoustID.

reason.description: Why the identification was not applied.

Role.description: What a user may do. Each role can do everything the previous one can.

RotationPick.description: A track rotation queued, and why.

played_at_unix_ms.description: When it started; missing until then, or if it never played.

track_id.description: Missing once the track is deleted.

RotationSettings.description: Station-wide rotation settings, stored under the `rotation` settings name.

oneOf.description: Where relaxation ends (steps 9 and 10). The whole library when unset.
Days of the week and hours of the day.

end_hour.description:
1 to 24, excluded. At or before `start_hour`, the hours run past
midnight and belong to the day they start on: Friday 22 to 2
covers Saturday 01:30.

oneOf.description: Dates, both included.

every_year.description:
Every year on these days and months (the years are ignored);
the range may run over the new year.

oneOf.description: Never directly after a track of this category.

ScanReport.description: Outcome of one scan, logged and served by `/api/v1/library/status`.

deferred.description: Files modified too recently (probably still being copied).

failed.description: Files that could not be read.

moved.description: Files found under a new path (same content as a missing track).

restored.description: Missing tracks whose file is back.

ScheduledHour.description: The clock running at an hour of the week.

SeparationOverrides.description:
Separation windows overridden by a category or a clock slot; missing
ones are inherited.

gap_minutes.description:
Minutes nothing could be picked (restrictions forbade every track):
the engine's fallback directory would play.

steps.description:
Picks per relaxation step, 0 to 10: every pick past step 0 is a
logged relaxation.

clock_id.description: Runs this clock at every hour instead of the schedule.

seed.description: To replay a simulation; random by default.

start_unix_ms.description: Now by default, after the plays so far.

SlotPreview.description: A slot as it will sound.

average_ms.description: Their average playable length; missing for an empty category.

beyond_hour.description:
Expected to start after the hour ends: it will not play (never for
a looping clock).

calls_per_hour.description: Times an hour of this clock calls the category.

expected_start_ms.description: When the slot is expected to start, from the top of the hour.

needed_tracks.description:
Tracks the category needs so its tracks are not repeated within
the track window without relaxation.

short.description: The category has fewer tracks than it needs: expect relaxations.

tracks.description: Tracks of the category rotation may pick (playable).

windows.description: Windows the slot applies (rotation settings, category, slot).

timezone.description:
IANA time zone the clocks and restrictions follow, e.g.
`Europe/Paris`. By default the server's (`TZ`), or UTC.

clock.description: The server clock's synchronization (the host's: containers share it).

server_time_unix_ms.description: The server's time, to compare with the browser's.

accept.description: `true` marks the artists similar; `false` dismisses the suggestion.

SyncStatus.description: Whether the engine runs with the configuration stored in the database.

oneOf.description: Dry run of an organization: lists the moves, changes nothing.
Carries out the moves of a dry run, as one batch.
Reverts a batch.

Applies a release picked on the review screen to a track: its tags
are written and it is filed where the layout says, as one batch.

Looks up the MusicBrainz relationships between the station's
artists ("member of", "is person", …) and suggests the links.

TaskRequest.description: A task, as stored in `library_tasks.params`. The tag is also its `kind`.

fade_out_start_ms.description: The crossfade point: where the next track starts.

TrackEvent.description: A track change reported by the engine.

TrackOverrides.description:
Per-track overrides (`track_overrides`). Missing fields use the analysis
and station settings.

enabled.description: Disabled tracks are never picked by autofill or rotation.

next_start_ms.description: When the incoming track starts, on the outgoing track's timeline.

overlap_ms.description: How long both tracks play at once (0: back to back).

oneOf.description: Settings to try; the stored ones when missing.

enabled.description: Disabled users cannot sign in, and their tokens stop working.

oneOf.description: Played closer to an earlier play than its windows allow.
Played where a restriction forbids it.
Not from the category its slot and step call for.

floor_db.description: Level of point 0; 255 is full scale (0 dBFS), on a dB scale.

peaks.description: One byte per point, base64: the highest sample peak in the interval.

WeightSettings.description: Weights move with plays and requests (multiplied by these factors).

play_factor.description: Each play multiplies the track's weights by this, 0.5 to 1 (1: weights stay).

request_factor.description: Each request multiplies the track's weights by this, 1 to 2 (1: weights stay).

Windows.description: Separation windows, in minutes; 0 turns a rule off.

album_min.description: Do not play the same album within.

artist_min.description: Do not play the same artist (or a similar one) within.

title_min.description: Do not play the same title (any version) within.

track_min.description: Do not play the same track within.
